$ curl -s /tenant/sessions?limit=2
{
  "data": [
    {
      "cwd": "/workspace",
      "id": 5,
      "last_message_at": "2026-06-11T10:02:00Z",
      "model": "claude-test",
      "session_key": "sess-golden",
      "started_at": "2026-06-11T10:00:00Z",
      "status": "active",
      "title": "Golden Session"
    }
  ]
}

$ curl -s -X POST -d '{"session_key":"sess-created","title":"Created","model":"claude-test","cwd":"/workspace"}' /tenant/sessions
{
  "id": 6
}

$ curl -s -X PATCH -d '{"title":"Renamed","status":"active"}' /tenant/sessions/5
{
  "id": 5
}

$ curl -s -X DELETE /tenant/sessions/5
{
  "archived": true,
  "id": 5
}

$ curl -s /tenant/messages?session_id=5&limit=10

  "data": [
    {

      "role": "assistant",

$ curl -s -X POST -d '{"session_id":5,"turn_index":3,"role":"user","content":"again"}' /tenant/messages
{
  "id": 9
}
